verdicts.reason: With the Harmony binding confirmed, the raid weight is multiplied by galeRaidWeightFactor only in enabled Gale. Non-raid weights are unchanged, non-Gale and disabled arms equal input, and no incident is triggered.
After reload, a routine haul crosses the armed island without a new order. The leaf says reload cannot authorize later automatic work.
A hediff appears but the parasite is not reduced compared with the control and remains after expiry. A badge while parasites remain fails the leaf.
Hand-sown fuzz and island-only vines stand in for natural ground cover. Other wildPlants rows are not counted and there is no disabled-row control.
The giant pursues the innocent nearest pawn without witness or fresh trail. Nearest-pawn substitution is explicitly a wrong world.
The later section states that ordinary thunderstep stamping remains current. Missing base stamping is a gap, not a deferral.
Common blocking must be strictly greater than 1.5. Refusing a body of exactly 1.5 applies >= instead of >.
Per-claim duration is frozen, and tuning changes apply only to later claims. The active claim's due date moved retroactively.
No guardian, farmer camp or drying-scar behavior or promises remain, and no tombstone is required. Retained tree systems pass separately, and the vaporator is inspected only locally.
A real harvest pays the integer bank once and retains the fraction. There is no duplicate on reload, and the canceled harvest does not debit the bank.
Idle small animals are held by the attributed Scrub replacement while large animals and the higher-priority flee continue. Wandering resumes after Stall, and the disabled control is shown.
Through real jobs, cane gives about double duration, more completed work and 1.25 times the heat rate. Mixed-fuel credit is conserved across reload, and a full stove takes no extra item.
The trader caravan, a non-raid worker, is multiplied by the Gale factor. The leaf requires other weights to stay unchanged.
Body 1.5 is refused at Thicket. Common blocking must be strictly greater than 1.5.
The second rub doubles the per-pulse reduction. A refresh must never stack strength.
The existing claim's saved duration and due tick change to the new tuning. Active claims must keep their frozen duration.
After reload, an automatic haul enters the armed hazard. Reload must not authorize later automatic work.
Heat-coupled consumers emit the same heat rate as wood. The leaf requires 1.25 times the matched wood heat rate while burning cane credit.
